priorityFixes.title: Strengthen safety guardrails and refusal patterns
priorityFixes.description: Enhance system prompt with explicit safety instructions. Add input/output filtering for harmful content detection.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Add comprehensive safety guidelines to the system prompt. Implement a pre-processing filter that detects and blocks prompt injection and jailbreak attempts before they reach the model.

priorityFixes.title: Improve error handling and failover mechanisms
priorityFixes.description: Enhance API key rotation, provider failover, and retry logic to handle all error states gracefully.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Add exponential backoff retry, circuit breaker pattern for failing providers, and better error categorization to distinguish between transient and permanent failures.

priorityFixes.title: Improve factual accuracy with enhanced web search integration
priorityFixes.description: Expand real-time search triggers and improve search context integration into system prompts. For ambiguous factual queries, always perform a web search before answering.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Expand searchKeywords array and lower the confidence threshold for web search inclusion. Add fallback to secondary search engines when primary fails.

priorityFixes.title: Improve code generation quality and correctness
priorityFixes.description: Enhance code generation context with explicit language version constraints, error handling patterns, and testing requirements.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Add code quality instructions: 'Always include error handling, use modern syntax, add type annotations, and provide usage examples.' Route coding queries to code-optimized models.

priorityFixes.title: Enhance chain-of-thought reasoning capability
priorityFixes.description: Add explicit step-by-step reasoning instructions to system prompts for Architect and General modes. Reduce temperature for reasoning-heavy queries.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Add 'Think step by step. Show your reasoning clearly before giving the final answer.' to system prompts. Implement automatic temperature scaling based on query complexity.

priorityFixes.title: Enhance response formatting and user experience
priorityFixes.description: Improve markdown rendering, code block formatting, and error message clarity.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Add better formatting for lists, tables, and structured data. Improve error messages to be more helpful and actionable. Add progress indicators during long operations.

priorityFixes.title: Fix conversation memory retention across turns
priorityFixes.description: Ensure full conversation context is preserved and passed correctly on follow-up queries. Fix message history trimming logic.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Increase maxHistory limits per provider. Implement smarter context window management that prioritizes recent messages while preserving key information from earlier turns.

priorityFixes.title: Optimize response latency
priorityFixes.description: Reduce first-token latency by optimizing provider selection, connection pooling, and streaming implementation.
priorityFixes.suggestedChange: Implement connection keep-alive, pre-warm model connections, and add latency-based provider selection that prefers faster providers for simple queries.
